title: The mutable-token bytecode scan cannot see an upgradeable proxy's implementation and matches selectors as raw substrings anywhere in the bytecode

evidence.note: getCode(token) then codeLower.includes(selector) over the whole bytecode
fixed list of 19 selectors; a renamed setter is invisible

sibling_sites_checked: Only caller pair: bot.ts:982 (V2 bank) and :1317 (V3 bank). No implementation-slot (EIP-1967) read anywhere in the slice. GoPlus returns is_proxy (goplus.ts:21) but the GoPlus token check is not called by the buy path (AUD-BUY-026).
severity_rationale: S2: the gate exists to stop "owner flips the tax after we buy" (comment :5-8). A proxy token passes it (getCode returns the proxy, whose code has none of the setter selectors) and can change behaviour after the buy; substring matching can also block a clean token whose bytecode contains the 8 hex digits elsewhere. Bounded: the roundtrip gate still measures tax at buy time. Candidate until a Phase 23 fork test shows a proxy token passing.
recommendation: Decide on card BUY-05 whether proxy tokens are blocked outright, scanned through their implementation slot, or accepted as today; match selectors only at PUSH4 positions if the scan stays. Behaviour change, Phase 24 or 29 per the card.
